title: Draft, check and change a process definition
description: A process designer writes a new process (a graph of start, task and end nodes) as a draft, checks it, changes it and finds it again. Only a draft can be changed; a draft that is not wanted is deleted.
preconditions: the tenant has the designer role holder
a unique process name and version

tasks.result: the editor opens an empty draft
a draft with a name, version and graph (201, status draft)
the graph is checked without saving; findings are listed (200 valid, 422 findings)
the draft is replaced (PUT) or partly changed (PATCH); a non-draft is refused with 409
the draft is found in the list, by search, by delta and by id
a draft is deleted for good (204); only a draft can be hard-deleted

refusals: a change to a non-draft gets 409
an unknown or other-tenant id gets the same 404

title: Activate, retire and archive a process definition
description: A designer or administrator turns a draft into the active version. Activation checks the graph, the scripts it binds and the services it calls and records who activated it. An active version can be re-activated when its activator lost authority, deprecated, and archived; delete on an active one deprecates then archives. No runner scenario covers this process directly: BP-DESIGNER-01 only exercises activation and the deprecate-then-archive that its cleanup DELETE performs.
preconditions: a draft that passes validation

tasks.result: the draft becomes ACTIVE; an already ACTIVE version answers 200 unchanged, a deprecated or archived one 409; a bad graph or an unusable service 422
an active version flagged needs_reactivation is re-activated in place; the caller becomes the signed activator
the version is deprecated (new instances refused, running ones continue) and then archived

refusals: activating an already ACTIVE version is idempotent (200, nothing changes); activating a deprecated or archived one gets 409
a module-owned version cannot be changed (409)

title: Export, import and roll back a process definition
description: A definition is exported as a file, imported into the same or another tenant as a new draft, and an administrator can roll the process back to an earlier version.
preconditions: an exported definition file with a known bpm_export_schema_version

tasks.result: the export file of one definition
the file becomes a new draft; an unknown schema version gets 422
the process key points again at an earlier version

refusals: rollback needs DefinitionsRollback (administrator only): 403 for the designer

title: Promote a definition from one tenant to another with review
description: An administrator plans a promotion of definitions from a source tenant, a second look (review) approves or rejects it, assertions run, and an approved promotion is applied. The auditor may read.
preconditions: the administrator owns the source tenant (stored-tenant check, decision 0046 D3)

tasks.result: a promotion plan and a promotion record
the context, assertions, approval or rejection
an approved promotion is applied to the target
the list, one promotion and the platform events are read only

refusals: a non-administrator gets 403 on every write
a foreign tenant's promotion id gets 404

title: Install, update and override a solution pack
description: A pack of definitions, entity types and forms is exported, installed, reviewed for an update (what changes, conflicts with the tenant's own overrides) and applied; an administrator keeps tenant overrides of pack parts as versions that are activated or retired.
preconditions: a pack file

tasks.result: a pack is exported and installed
the update plan is read and applied; an override conflict also needs SolutionOverridesManage
tenant overrides are listed, created, versioned, activated and retired

refusals: an override write without SolutionOverridesManage gets 403
a module-owned pack part cannot be changed

title: Define an entity type (a record kind) and activate it
description: A designer defines a record type with named, typed fields, activates it with a rationale, and reads definitions. An administrator may add tenant `x_` fields to a module-owned type and retire them.
preconditions: the type name is not a module-managed one

tasks.result: a draft entity definition (201); a managed type name is refused
the definition is activated with a rationale
definitions are read by id, by name, the active one and the list
x_ extension fields are added, listed and retired on a module-owned type

refusals: a type hidden from the caller gets 403 identical to an absent one

title: Create, change, find and attach to records
description: A user with record write creates, updates and deletes records of an active type; reads them through the query and aggregate routes, the list screen and reports; attaches files and reads the history of a record.
preconditions: an active entity type

tasks.result: a record is created, updated, deleted
records are queried and aggregated (restricted fields hidden)
reports are built over the entity type
files are attached, listed, read and removed
the change history of one record

refusals: a role without record write gets 403
a record outside the caller's scope or another tenant: 404

title: Import and export records, import field restrictions
description: An administrator exports records of a type to a file (redacted unless unredacted export is allowed), imports records from a file (the storekeeper only opening lines) and loads field restrictions.
preconditions: a file in the import format

tasks.result: an export file of a record type
records are imported atomically from a file
field restrictions are loaded

refusals: import of another type than opening lines without EntitiesRecordsImportAnyType: 403
a malformed file: nothing is written

title: Save and share a list view of records
description: A user opens saved views of a record type; an administrator creates, changes and deletes them.
preconditions: an active entity type

tasks.result: views are listed and opened
a view is created, changed, deleted

title: Derive field values before a record is saved (entity type hook)
description: A script administrator binds a published script to an entity type to derive values before a record is written, tries it on sample input (dry run) and removes it. The script runs in a sandbox with a read fingerprint.
preconditions: a published entity_write script

tasks.result: the bindings are listed
a script is bound to a type and removed
a dry run on sample input

refusals: binding needs ScriptsPublish: the designer gets 403
a script failure fails the record write closed

title: Run a script after a record event (record trigger)
description: An administrator binds a published script to the event of an entity type (created, updated...) so that the engine runs it when the event happens.
preconditions: a published script

tasks.result: the bindings are listed
a binding is set or removed

title: Write, test, publish and withdraw a business rule script
description: A designer writes a versioned script (rule), tests it with its stored test cases and a dry run; an administrator publishes it (the author does not confirm their own), retires or revokes it, and the audit of a version is read. Scripts run in a sandbox with a hash that binds the content, a tenant HMAC key, validation and a policy.
preconditions: scripts not killed by the tenant kill switch

tasks.result: scripts and versions are listed and read
a draft version is created, changed, deleted
a dry run and a form-validation dry run on sample input
a version is published, retired, revoked, confirmed
the audit of a version

title: Set the tenant's script policy
description: An administrator switches all scripts off (kill switch), turns separation of duties on or off for publishing, and flags which entity types scripts may read.

tasks.result: the policy, the scripts waiting for review and the readable types are read
kill switch and separation of duties are set
a type is made readable by scripts or cleared

refusals: a role without ScriptsPublish gets 403 on every write

title: Start a process and follow it
description: A user who may start processes starts an instance of an active definition; the board and the detail page show where it is (history, timeline, version pins). An operator cancels, rebuilds a broken instance from history, moves a timer on, or re-pins it to the newer active version.
preconditions: an active definition

tasks.result: an instance starts (201); initial variables cannot overwrite engine-owned targets
the board, detail, history, timeline and pins
cancel, rebuild, re-pin, advance a timer

refusals: a body field that targets an engine-owned variable is refused 422 output_refused

title: Attach files to a running process instance
description: A user attaches a file to an instance, lists and opens it, shares a time-limited link, removes it; storage use is shown.
preconditions: a running instance

tasks.result: a file is uploaded and removed
the list, one file, the viewer page and storage use
a link is issued and read

refusals: type and size limits refuse the upload

title: Work the task inbox
description: A person sees the tasks addressed to them, their groups or roles (an operator or administrator sees all), claims and completes a task; an operator assigns or reassigns it.
preconditions: a running instance with a task

tasks.result: the inbox, the task list and one task
a task is claimed and completed; the completion body cannot overwrite write targets
a task is assigned or reassigned (a role-routed task needs the role or TasksReassignRouted)

refusals: a user outside the routing role/group gets 404 or 403
a completion body that sets an engine-owned variable is refused

title: Retry or discard failed jobs (dead-letter queue)
description: An operator reads the failed deliveries and retries or discards each.
preconditions: a failed job exists

tasks.result: the queue and one entry
retry or discard

title: Notify another system by webhook
description: An operator subscribes a URL to events, reads the delivery log, changes and deletes the subscription. The URL is validated (no private or internal addresses) and the HMAC secret is shown once.
preconditions: a public https endpoint

tasks.result: the list and the delivery log
a subscription is created, changed, deleted

title: Map fields for an integration
description: An administrator defines how external field names map to the tenant's field names.

tasks.result: a mapping is created, listed, read, changed, deleted

title: Run a job on a schedule
description: An administrator defines a scheduled job, switches it on or off, edits it and reads it.

tasks.result: a job is created, edited, enabled, disabled, listed

title: Govern documents: retention, hold and print forms
description: An administrator sets how long a kind of document is kept, puts a document on hold and releases it, keeps the tenant's own print layout (override) and the company's version of an official form.

tasks.result: retention of a document type and a hold on one document
print overrides: list, read, create, activate, retire
company official-form templates: list, starter, read, download, preview, create, activate, retire, roll back

title: Share a record read-only with an outside person (public read)
description: An administrator issues a handle for one record kind and id; the outside person opens the public address with the handle and sees a fixed projection. Any unknown, wrong, revoked or expired handle gives the same 404.
preconditions: a record kind registered for public read

tasks.result: a handle is issued
the public projection (no login; no store, no referrer, no index; rate limited)

refusals: unknown kind or handle, revoked, expired, wrong kind: uniform 404

title: List the services a process may call
description: A designer looks up the services the tenant may use as service tasks in a process.

tasks.result: the services usable by the tenant

title: SECURITY: permission matrix of the designer area, role by role
description: Each write route of the area is refused with 403 to a role that does not hold its permission (storekeeper, task worker, auditor, operator where only the designer or administrator may), and answered to the holder. The matrix is `priv/permission_matrix/effective.golden`; holders: DefinitionsWrite [PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_DESIGNER, TENANT_ADMIN]; ScriptsWrite [PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_DESIGNER, TENANT_ADMIN]; ScriptsPublish [PLATFORM_ADMIN, TENANT_ADMIN]; DlqOperate [PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_OPERATOR, TENANT_ADMIN]; WebhooksManage [PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_OPERATOR, TENANT_ADMIN]; EntitiesDefinitionsWrite [PLATFORM_ADMIN, PROCESS_DESIGNER, TENANT_ADMIN]; PromotionsManage [PLATFORM_ADMIN, TENANT_ADMIN].
preconditions: roster: storekeeper and administrator of the QA tenant

tasks.result: 403 on create definition, create entity type, create script version, set kill switch, subscribe webhook, retry a dead letter, create a promotion; nothing changed

refusals: 403 for a role without the permission, before the body is read
security_status: automated (storekeeper only); planned for the roles with no roster actor (process designer, operator, task worker, auditor)

title: SECURITY: cross-tenant read and write refused, uniform 404
description: A token of tenant A used on an id of tenant B (definition, entity definition, record, instance, task, webhook subscription, script version, promotion, attachment) answers the same 404 as an id that does not exist; no write happens. Isolation is the schema-per-tenant prefix (INV-1, INV-5, INV-10).
preconditions: two tenants and a token of each

tasks.result: the same 404 bytes for a foreign id and an absent id on every id route (covered by the Elixir tests)

security_status: partial: the absent-id half is automated in BP-DESIGNER-26; the two-token half is planned (the runner runs one tenant per run)

title: SECURITY: unknown, malformed and absent ids answer one uniform 404
description: An id that does not exist in the tenant is answered by the same 404 on the read and the write routes of definitions, with no change.

tasks.result: 404 on read, activate and delete of an unknown definition id
404 on a public read with an unknown kind and handle (not in the runner scenario: no public route in the static check)

security_status: automated for the definition routes; planned for the public address

title: SECURITY: crafted start and completion refused (write targets)
description: Starting an instance of a definition whose nodes carry module write targets through POST /instances is refused with 404 (the answer for an unknown definition, INV-5) and nothing is started; a task completion body that names an engine-owned variable or a module write target is refused with 422 output_refused and nothing is written (T-2429, T-2443; commit 3a84f6a2b).
preconditions: a process whose steps write a protected target

tasks.result: 404, nothing started (a module-write definition cannot be started publicly)
422 output_refused for a crafted body, nothing written

refusals: start of a module-write definition: 404, nothing started
completion with crafted body: 422 output_refused, no write
security_status: planned: the stock BP-09 scenario (stock area) covers the module case; a designer-area generic scenario needs a test definition

title: SECURITY: token and host lookup (wrong, expired, other-tenant token; unknown host)
description: A request with no token, a bad or expired token, or a token of another tenant's issuer is refused 401 with the same body, before any handler runs. (No host-based tenant lookup exists in the API plugs; the unknown-host case is not claimed.)

tasks.result: 401 on every route of the area without a valid token

security_status: planned: the runner steps always carry an actor token; a no-token step kind is needed

title: SECURITY: upload types and limits
description: An instance attachment whose declared content type is outside the allowlist (415, REQ-389, Letflow.Repository.Attachments.upload/2) or over the 25 MiB ceiling (413) is refused and nothing is stored; a record attachment over the size ceiling is refused 413 (its type check is not confirmed here); a malformed import file writes nothing.

tasks.result: 415 for a declared content type outside the allowlist, 413 over the size ceiling; nothing stored (the type is the caller-declared one, not sniffed)
413 over the size ceiling, nothing stored
a malformed import file writes nothing

security_status: planned: the runner has no multipart step kind

title: SECURITY: outbound URLs, webhook inputs and the public handle
description: A webhook URL that points at a private or internal address is refused (INV-9); the HMAC secret is shown once; the public read handle gives only the fixed projection and one uniform 404.

tasks.result: an unsafe URL is refused
a handle for a kind that is not registered is refused

security_status: planned: an operator actor is not in the roster

title: SECURITY: separation of duties for scripts and definitions
description: With separation of duties on, the author of a script version may not confirm or publish it; activating a definition records the signed activator and a changed authority flags re-activation; module-owned versions are immutable to the tenant.
preconditions: sod on (PUT /script-policy/sod)

tasks.result: the author's own confirmation is refused
the activator is recorded; a lost-authority activation needs re-activation

security_status: planned: needs two administrators (admin2 is a precondition of the roster)

title: SECURITY: scripts are sandboxed and can be switched off
description: A script runs with no access to the file system, network or other tenants; the kill switch stops every script of the tenant; a script failure fails the write closed (INV-3).

tasks.result: the kill switch stops script runs

refusals: script_busy / killed: the run is refused, the record write fails closed
security_status: planned: a kill-switch step would stop other sessions' scripts on the shared QA tenant; run on a private tenant only

title: SECURITY: module-managed entity types cannot be redefined by the tenant
description: A tenant request to define or write a managed entity type (owned by an installed module) is refused with entity_type_managed.
preconditions: an installed module that owns a type

tasks.result: a definition with a managed name is refused

security_status: planned: the managed name of the QA tenant must be read at run time
